scope: Missing/malformed COUNTRY.SYS and EGA775.CPI through the shipped C:\DOS startup paths on installed ET/LV/LT HIGH/LOW profiles. Exact country rejection errors, complete active-country checks, page/font bookkeeping, retained VGA font bytes, valid-resource recovery, unsupported country/page rejection, final physical BIOS keyboard input and restored installed payload hashes. Font height is the shipped 16-pixel profile. Does not qualify CONFIG boot fallback, real-BIOS installed failures, later media I/O rollback, installed text/file workflows or a source-matched final release.

cases.name: et-high
cases.config:
COUNTRY=372,775,C:\DOS\COUNTRY.SYS
DEVICE=C:\DOS\HIMEM.SYS
DEVICE=C:\DOS\EMM386.EXE NOEMS
DOS=HIGH,UMB
DEVICE=C:\DOS\DISPLAY.SYS CON=(EGA,437,(1,3))
NUMLOCK=ON

default_gate: make test-baltic-installed-resources-qemu creates its own complete installation run before the failure cases. The retained run used the explicitly selected, already completed installation above and checked all installed hashes.
